title: Paratus launches in Malawi with Starlink enterprise service
summary: Paratus Malawi now sells managed Starlink connectivity to businesses and institutions, with local installation and support. Paratus says it has already signed several enterprise customers.

title: Space42 introduces advertising-funded Wi-Fi hotspots in South Africa
summary: Public Wi-Fi hotspots running on Space42's YahClick satellite broadband, paid for by advertisers. Users watch a 30-second video for 20 minutes of free access, and network partners share in the revenue.

title: Starlink grant to connect childcare institutions in nine African countries
value_text: About $1 million (covers 16 countries, not only Africa)
summary: SpaceX is giving US non-profit Both Ends Believing 750 Starlink kits with installation and 12 months of free service for residential childcare institutions in 16 countries, nine of them in Africa.

title: Nigeria completes bidding for four more satellites, with contract awards awaiting FEC approval
parties: Federal Ministry of Innovation, Science and Technology
summary: Minister Kingsley Udeh said international bidding for four additional satellites is complete and winning bidders have been recommended. Bidders came from China, Israel, Europe, the US and Nigeria. Awards still need Federal Executive Council approval.

title: Paratus launches in Lesotho with Starlink enterprise connectivity
summary: Paratus Lesotho, a joint venture of Paratus Group and Real Image Lesotho, opened with Starlink enterprise connectivity alongside Paratus network services for businesses and organisations.

title: Senegal's Supreme Court confirms suspension of Starlink's licence and rejects state challenge
summary: The court upheld the provisional suspension it ordered on 7 September after Sonatel's challenge, and rejected the state's appeal against it. A ruling on the merits is still to come.

title: South Africa publishes draft Space Industry Regulatory Bill to replace the 1993 Act
parties: Department of Trade, Industry and Competition
summary: Published in the Government Gazette by Minister Parks Tau. If enacted it becomes the Space Industry Regulatory Act, 2026, replacing the Space Affairs Act, 1993.

title: Tanzania and Angola sign ICT cooperation MoU covering ANGOSAT-2 services
summary: Signed in Dar es Salaam during President Lourenço's state visit. Tanzania stated interest in using ANGOSAT-2 services; the MoU is a cooperation framework, not a capacity contract.

title: Roscosmos and Tanzania sign space memorandum; Russia to launch Tanzania's first EO satellite in 2027
parties: Tanzania Ministry of Communication and Information Technology
summary: Framework memorandum signed at the Russia-Africa Summit in Moscow. Roscosmos confirmed a March 2027 launch for Tanzania's first Earth remote-sensing satellite.

title: Kenya appoints Salience Consulting-led consortium to advise on commercial spaceport
summary: Transaction advisory for a proposed commercial spaceport, following a funding agreement for the feasibility study signed on 1 October 2026.

title: SES and Canal+ extend satellite capacity partnership to 2040
summary: Multi-year extension covering SES capacity across several orbital positions for Canal+ in Europe, Africa and the Caribbean. Satellites and African markets were not named.

title: MTN Uganda launches Starlink for Business
summary: MTN Uganda, an authorised Starlink reseller, launched Starlink for Business for organisations in remote parts of the country, following its August partnership announcement.

title: Kenya's Communications Authority publishes draft satellite frequency licensing framework
summary: The draft sets the licences and frequency authorisations needed for GSO and NGSO satellite services, starting with Landing Rights Authorisation. Public comments were due by 6 November 2026.

title: Eutelsat renews TV capacity deal with Télédiffusion d'Algérie
summary: Long-term renewal on EUTELSAT 7 West A at 7/8° West, keeping Algerian TV channels on air across the Middle East and North Africa.

title: Paratus Namibia launches Eutelsat OneWeb service
summary: Paratus starts selling OneWeb low Earth orbit connectivity in Namibia under its Southern Africa distribution deal with Eutelsat.

title: Satlyt raises $8M seed round
summary: Kenyan-founded startup raises seed funding for software that lets satellites process data and run AI in orbit.

title: Airtel Africa launches Starlink Mobile in Uganda
summary: Airtel Uganda customers with compatible phones can use SMS and light data apps where there is no mobile coverage, with a free 30-day trial. It is the second African market after DR Congo.

title: NigComSat selects Hughes JUPITER gateway for NigComSat-2A and 2B
summary: First public ground-segment contract on the NigComSat-2 programme: multi-band Ka/Ku/C gateway plus support for local terminal assembly.

title: Thales Alenia Space contracted to build NigComSat-2A
summary: Spacebus B2 GEO satellite of nearly 4 tonnes, coverage from West and Central Africa to Southern Africa, 15+ year life.

title: Senegal's Supreme Court suspends Starlink's licence after Sonatel challenge
summary: The court provisionally suspended Starlink's operating licence while it hears a challenge brought by incumbent operator Sonatel.

title: Starlink residential service goes live in Uganda
summary: Starlink opened residential orders in Uganda, following the five-year operating licence signed with the Uganda Communications Commission in May 2026.

title: Starlink goes live in Equatorial Guinea
summary: Starlink opened orders in Equatorial Guinea under a provisional approval granted on 29 July 2026, with state company GITGE to assess the service before long-term conditions are set.

title: MTN Uganda partners with Starlink for enterprise connectivity
summary: MTN Uganda extended MTN Group's Starlink arrangement to Uganda to offer satellite internet to enterprise customers in remote and underserved areas.

title: Paratus Uganda becomes first provider to launch Starlink services in Uganda
summary: Paratus Uganda, a joint venture of Paratus Group and Roke Telkom, launched Starlink services for enterprise customers. Paratus says Uganda is its ninth African country offering Starlink.

title: Nigeria approves NigComSat-2A and 2B; Thales Alenia Space and IAI selected
summary: Federal Executive Council approves two high-throughput satellites to replace NigComSat-1R; launches targeted for 2028 and 2029.

title: Airtel Africa launches Starlink Mobile commercially in DR Congo
summary: First commercial satellite-to-mobile service in Africa, launched in Kinshasa under Airtel Africa's December 2025 Direct to Cell agreement with SpaceX.

title: Amazon Leo partners with Herotel to launch satellite broadband in South Africa
summary: Amazon's first satellite internet agreement in Africa; consumer service planned for 2027.

title: South Africa launches state-backed BrainSAT with Space42
summary: New local company, partnered with Space42, offers YahClick broadband and Thuraya mobile satellite services under the national SATCOM strategy.

title: Eutelsat signs multi-year LEO agreement with Mercury (Sonangol) in Angola
summary: Mercury will use Eutelsat OneWeb LEO services for public, private, offshore and telecom customers across Angola.

title: Côte d'Ivoire grants Starlink a provisional licence
summary: Regulator ARTCI issued a 12-month provisional licence, with service due to start in July 2026.

title: Telecom Namibia signs Angosat-2 pilot commercial agreement with GGPEN
summary: Signed at ANGOTIC in Luanda, the deal moves from proof of concept to a live-network trial of Angosat-2 VSAT services for remote areas of Namibia.

title: Amazon Kuiper Kenya applies for International Gateway Operator licence
summary: Gazette notice confirms a 15-year licence application for what would be Amazon Leo's first African gateway.

title: Uganda grants Starlink an operating licence
summary: Operational licence agreement signed between the regulator and Starlink, announced by President Museveni.

title: ICASA says Starlink-style equity alternatives need a change in law
parties: Department of Communications and Digital Technologies
summary: Regulator states that recognising equity equivalent investment programmes would require amending the Electronic Communications Act.

title: Uganda, Kenya, Rwanda and South Sudan agree feasibility study for a shared comms satellite
summary: Ministers signed a resolution for a 12 to 18 month study of a regionally owned communication and broadcasting satellite.

title: Algeria opens tender for two satellite licences, including NGSO operators
summary: Regulator ARPCE invited bids from VSAT licence holders and global non-geostationary constellations, opening the market to new entrants.

title: Namibia's regulator denies Starlink a licence
summary: CRAN turned down Starlink's application to operate in Namibia.

title: Orange Tunisie launches nationwide satellite internet
summary: Service of up to 100 Mbps, following Orange's partnership with Eutelsat across Africa and the Middle East.

title: AXIAN Telecom (Yas) and AST SpaceMobile partner on direct-to-device network
summary: BlueBird satellites to be integrated with Yas core networks for voice, video and data straight to ordinary smartphones.

title: MTN Zambia completes Africa's first Starlink Direct to Cell field test
summary: First data session and fintech transaction over MTN spectrum and Starlink satellites; commercial launch subject to ZICTA approval.

title: Vodafone and Amazon Leo sign backhaul deal, with Africa rollout through Vodacom
summary: LEO backhaul for remote 4G/5G sites at up to 1 Gbps down, starting in Europe and then across Vodacom's African markets.

title: Central African Republic grants Starlink an operating licence
summary: The licence brings the number of African countries where Starlink operates to 27.

title: Amazon Leo and Vanu partner on rural mobile broadband in Africa
summary: Vanu's Coverage as a Service sites to use Amazon Leo satellite backhaul for 4G and 5G in underserved communities.

title: Seychelles approves Starlink licence
summary: Licence approved for 115 islands, with conditions.

title: Nigeria grants landing permits to Amazon Leo, NSLComm and Satelio
summary: The Nigerian Communications Commission issued seven-year landing permits to the three satellite operators.

title: Airtel Africa signs Starlink Direct to Cell deal for all 14 markets
summary: Satellite-to-phone service for Airtel's 174 million customers from 2026, subject to approval in each country.

title: Sonatel (Orange) launches satellite broadband in Senegal
summary: First unlimited satellite broadband offers for homes and businesses, using Eutelsat KONNECT.

title: MSTelcom (Sonangol) to distribute Eutelsat OneWeb in Angola
summary: Distribution for enterprise, public sector and telecom customers, including oil and gas and maritime; Eutelsat is Angola's only licensed LEO operator.

title: Eutelsat and Paratus sign multi-year OneWeb deal for Southern Africa
summary: Expanded LEO services for fixed sites, comms-on-the-move and comms-on-pause across five countries.

title: Thuraya enters South Africa with Thuraya-4 commercial rollout
summary: Thuraya's first operational entry into South Africa, targeting energy, mining, maritime, government and humanitarian users.

title: Rwanda and SpaceX plan first Starlink gateway in Rwanda
summary: Planned gateway to complement Starlink's Nigerian gateways and Nairobi point of presence.

title: Starlink secures operating licence in DR Congo
summary: Starlink's 22nd African market, after launches in Lesotho and Guinea-Bissau in April 2025.

title: Orange MEA and Eutelsat sign multi-year satellite broadband partnership
summary: Orange to use EUTELSAT KONNECT for up to 100 Mbps service, starting with Côte d'Ivoire, Senegal, DRC and Jordan.

title: NIGCOMSAT and Eutelsat sign LEO services partnership for Nigeria
summary: Multi-year deal for NIGCOMSAT to sell OneWeb connectivity to government, enterprise and rural users in Nigeria.

title: Starlink opens point of presence in Nairobi
summary: Regional routing node; reported latency for Kenyan users fell from 100–200 ms to about 30 ms.
